title: Nanite Geometry Rasterization & Shading Overhead
fix_rationale: Nanite cluster rasterization, programmable raster binning, or World Position Offset (WPO) evaluation are causing GPU bottlenecks.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time) during Nanite cluster rasterization.

fixes.text: Tune Nanite max pixels per edge (r.Nanite.MaxPixelsPerEdge 1.0 to 1.5) to reduce cluster density.
Disable World Position Offset (WPO) evaluation on distant Nanite instances (r.Nanite.WPO 1, r.Nanite.WPO.MaxDistance).
Audit programmable raster materials (masked/translucent) on Nanite meshes to minimize shading binning costs.

verify: Adjust r.Nanite.MaxPixelsPerEdge and verify that Nanite rasterization times decrease.
